relationships.subject: microglial CB2 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: deletion of CB2 receptors from microglia in CX3CR1-Cnr2 mice significantly (p < 0.05) increased tail flick latency compared with the wild type C57BL/6 and DAT-Cnr2 group

relationships.subject: mu-opioid receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared to the C57BL/6, Tukey’s test revealed that there was statistically significant increase (p < 0.05) in the levels of IL-β and IL-6 as evidenced by enhanced absorbance values, in MOR KO mice.

key_findings: Microglial CB2 deletion (CX3Cr1-Cnr2 cKO) increased tail-flick latency more than MOR KO or DAT-Cnr2 cKO
MOR KO mice showed elevated IL-1beta and IL-6 and region-specific cytokine differences between cerebellum and PFC
